title: GPU inference telemetry contract v1: shared definitions
description: Envelope, resource attributes, and field types shared by every event in contract major version 1. Event schemas compose these definitions; they are not validated on their own.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of the contract the producer emitted against. Must be major version 1 for this schema set.

event_id.description: Unique ID for this event record (UUID). Lets consumers de-duplicate replays.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with a Z suffix and optional fractional seconds.

tier.description: Inference tier. 'small' is the single-GPU tier (RequestQueue); 'large' is the multi-GPU tensor-parallel tier (LargeModelRequestQueue).

request_id.description: Inference request ID (UUID v4), as validated by the SQS worker.

xid_code.description: NVIDIA XID codes on which Amazon ECS marks a Managed Instance IMPAIRED and auto-repair replaces it. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonECS/latest/developerguide/managed-instances-gpu-auto-repair.html (18 codes as of contract 1.0.0).

resource_common.description: Resource attributes (OpenTelemetry semantic-convention names where one exists) identifying what emitted the event. Event schemas pick which optional keys they require and close the object with unevaluatedProperties.

envelope.description: Top-level shape shared by every event. Each event schema pins event_name and supplies the resource and attributes constraints.

timestamp.description: When the producer emitted this record (not when the underlying condition occurred).
